einleitung: Enter your customer number and the date of birth of the main person once. After that, this phone remembers your place.
geburtsdatum: Date of birth of the main person
datenschutz: We only store that this phone belongs to your household.
falsch: Customer number or date of birth is not correct.
gesperrt: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
zu_viele: Enough phones are already set up for your household. Please ask at the entrance.
nicht_verfuegbar: This display is not available at your distribution point.
code_ungueltig: This code is no longer valid. Please sign in with your customer number and date of birth.
kein_termin: It is not your turn today, or the distribution has not started yet.
vorschau: The distribution has not started yet. There will probably be {vor} ahead of you.
aufgerufen: You have already been called. Please come to the entrance.
erledigt: You have already been here today. See you next time!
aktualisiert: As of {uhrzeit} – the page updates itself.
push_ist_an: Notifications are on: you will get a message shortly before it is your turn – even if this page is closed.
push_iphone: For notifications on an iPhone: tap “Share” at the bottom, then “Add to Home Screen”. Then open the waiting time using the new icon.
push_nicht: This browser cannot show notifications. The page still updates by itself.
push_blockiert: Notifications are blocked for this page. Please allow them in your browser settings.
push_fehler: That did not work. Please try again later.
push_bald: {vor} ahead of you – please come to the entrance.
